chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdul-Hamid ibn Saeed, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the door of Al-Safa. I said, 'Our companions have differed regarding it; some say it is the one next to the watering place (Zamzam), and some say it is the one next to the Stone.' He said: 'It is the one next to the watering place. It was newly made by Dawood, and Dawood opened it.'

key_terms.السِّقَايَةَ: The watering place, referring specifically to the Zamzam well.
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ: The Stone, referring to the Black Stone (Al-Hajar Al-Aswad).
key_terms.بَابِ الصَّفَا: The door of Al-Safa, a specific entrance in the Holy Kaaba or its vicinity associated with the Sa'i ritual.
key_terms.مُحْدَثٌ: Newly made / recent construction, indicating it was not the original door from the time of the Prophet or Ibrahim.

ai.seo_question: Which door is considered the 'door of Al-Safa' according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) resolves the scholarly dispute regarding the 'door of Al-Safa' by identifying it as the entrance adjacent to the Zamzam well, specifically noting it as a later construction by Dawood. This clarification aligns the physical structure with the ritual of Sa'i, emphasizing the historical evolution of the Sacred House's architecture as understood in Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Hameed Bin Saeed who said,

‘I asked Abu Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> about the door of Al-Safa. I said, ‘Our companions have differed with regards to it. Some of them are saying, ‘(It is that) which is next to the watering place (Zamzam)’, and some of them are saying, ‘(It is that) which is next to the (Black) Stone’.’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is which is next to the watering place (Zamzam). It was newly made by Dawood, and Dawood opened it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Servants (of Allah) al-Hamid ibn Sa‘id who has said the following:

“I asked abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the door of al-Safa’ saying, ‘Our people have differences about it. Certain ones among them say, “It is in front of the water fountain and others say that it is in front of the Black Stone.’” He (the Imam) said, ‘It is the one which is in front of the water fountain. Dawud initiated it and Dawud was the one who opened it.’”
